thread:
Aisha: Final call for the launch blog publish checklist. Target window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need quick ACKs on copy, visuals, HS mapping, and webinar flow.
Tom: I reviewed draft — two tiny headline variants attached. Prefer the shorter one for social.
Rena: Visuals: hero v3 approved, but CTA button color needs AA contrast. Uploaded updated asset: drive/app_hero_v3_contrast.png
Diego: HubSpot form exists: form id launch_signup_2026. Currently captures email, name, company, role. We should add 'region' and 'primary_use_case'.
Aisha: Add region + use_case. Also ensure "source" hidden field = "launch_blog_apr" for attribution.
Diego: Will add fields and set hidden source. Also will set dedupe on email + company combo.
Tom: Benchmarks: we have two callouts. Per Legal, include parenthetical method note. Example: "(internal benchmark vs baseline model, 95th percentile, N=50)"
Rena: I'll add the microcopy under each callout and make it 12px/secondary color.
Kai: Webinar: registration link should open modal and also send attendee to /webinars/launch-apr?utm=blog. Modal form must reuse HS id.
Aisha: Good. Modal triggers: on-scroll 50% and after 30s. Also sticky footer CTA.
Diego: HubSpot mapping snippet: email -> contact.email, name -> contact.firstname, company -> company.name, role -> contact.job_title, region -> contact.hs_region, primary_use_case -> contact.hs_use_case, source -> contact.hs_source_hidden
Tom: Content edit: change "dominant" to "leading" in paragraph 3 to avoid marketing absolutes.
Aisha: Done in draft. Also swapped headline to Variant B for SEO length.
Rena: Legal note: remove mention of competitor by name in benchmark paragraph. Replaced with "comparable open models".
Aisha: Thanks — updated.
Diego: PublishBot, can you create a staging preview with updated form and modal?
PublishBot: Preview generated: https://staging.redwood.ai/blog/preview/1733337777 — modal behavior and HS form wired.
Kai: QAed the preview. Modal fires correctly. Form now includes region and use_case. Hidden source set. Confirmed redirect to /webinars/launch-apr with utm.
Tom: Quick copy pass done. Social-ready headline pinned.
Rena: Visuals final. Hero + deck + inline screenshots uploaded.
Diego: HS mapping pushed. Also added workflow to tag contact property "funnel_stage=top_of_funnel" and route to queue growth-eu/growth-na based on region. Overflow to growth-oncall after 20m.
Aisha: All signoffs needed: Tom (content), Rena (design), Diego (ops), Kai (webinar flow). Please react with :thumbsup: if approved.
Tom: :thumbsup: content approved.
Rena: :thumbsup: design approved.
Diego: :thumbsup: HS mapping + routing approved.
Kai: :thumbsup: webinar flow looks good.
Aisha: Locking assets. Final publish slated 09:00 PT. If any edits after this, include a short changelog in the thread. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
